answer: Each agent must maintain a personal lagoon of time-weighted reputation that only grows when the agent solves a live comet-path puzzle derived from external entropy unavailable to precomputation. The puzzle runs under a strict sable compute budget enforced by peer-verified wall-clock timing. An attacker creating many Sybils faces a linear cost in continuous unique puzzle-solving time and bandwidth that cannot be amortized across identities, since each path is identity-bound and entropy-fresh.
